jobs.title: Director, Product Owner, Release & Operations Management
jobs.description:
We’re building a relationship-oriented bank for the modern world. We need talented, passionate professionals who are dedicated to doing what’s right for our clients.

At CIBC, we embrace your strengths and your ambitions, so you are empowered at work. Our team members have what they need to make a meaningful impact and are truly valued for who they are and what they contribute.

To learn more about CIBC, please visit CIBC.com

What You'll Be Doing

The team supporting the CRTeX platform plays an important role in delivering reliable, well-governed technology solutions that help business and technology partners operate with confidence. As a Director, Product Owner, Release & Operations Management, you'll lead the product direction for release and operational management capabilities across a complex enterprise environment. You'll own the backlog and roadmap, bringing together business priorities, delivery needs, testing requirements, and operational readiness to support stable, high-quality releases. You'll work closely with engineering teams, business stakeholders, operations, and support partners to coordinate release planning, pilot execution, production readiness, and continuous improvement. You'll also help strengthen operational excellence by managing risks, dependencies, and escalations, while identifying opportunities to improve delivery efficiency through automation and process optimization.

At CIBC we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. You'll have the flexibility to manage your work activities within a hybrid work arrangement where you'll spend 1-3 days per week on-site, while other days will be remote.

How You'll Succeed

Product ownership and prioritization - Own and prioritize the product backlog for Release & Operations Management capabilities, and define a roadmap aligned to business, delivery, and operational objectives.
Release planning and governance - Lead end-to-end release planning, coordination, and execution across multiple teams, ensuring clear timelines, readiness gates, go/no-go criteria, and strong governance throughout the delivery lifecycle.
Testing and quality management - Oversee testing and release-quality activities across system integration testing, regression testing, end-to-end integration, user acceptance testing, performance testing, and production-readiness reviews to ensure critical defects and gaps are addressed before release.
Pilot execution and rollout readiness - Lead pilot planning and execution, including readiness assessments, test scenarios, issue triage, stakeholder coordination, pilot governance, and exit criteria to support successful transition to broader production rollout.
Operational excellence - Support production readiness, operational stability, and adherence to change management processes by managing incidents, risks, dependencies, and escalations that affect delivery and live environments.
Continuous improvement and collaboration - Partner with engineering, operations, and business teams to improve processes, increase automation, and lead Agile ceremonies such as backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives.

Who You Are

You are a caring and accountable leader. You have experience developing and implementing strategic team goals. You have experience coaching employees and inspiring successful team performance.
You know that details matter. You notice things that others don't. Your critical thinking skills help to inform your decision making.
You're motivated by collective success. You know that teamwork can transform a good idea into a great one. You know that an inclusive team that enjoys working together can bring a vision to life.
You embrace and advocate for change. You continuously evolve your thinking and the way you work in order to deliver your best.
You can demonstrate experience in Product Ownership, technology delivery, release management, operations management, Agile delivery, Scrum, SAFe, release hardening, testing governance, production readiness, defect management, DevOps practices, continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines, and change management. It’s an asset if you have experience in financial services or another highly regulated environment.
You have a degree/diploma in business, technology, engineering, computer science, or a related field. Equivalent practical experience in enterprise technology delivery and operations management is also valued.
You live your values. You bring high standards, genuine care to your relationships, and want to grow with an employer that shares your values and brings out your best.

What CIBC Offers

At CIBC, your goals are a priority. We start with your strengths and ambitions as an employee and strive to create opportunities to tap into your potential. We aspire to give you a career, rather than just a paycheck.

We work to recognize you in meaningful, personalized ways including a competitive salary, incentive pay, banking benefits, a benefits program*, defined benefit pension plan*, an employee share purchase plan, a vacation offering, wellbeing support, and MomentMakers, our social, points-based recognition program.
Our spaces and technological toolkit will make it simple to bring together great minds to create innovative solutions that make a difference for our clients.
We cultivate a culture where you can express your ambition through initiatives like Purpose Day; a paid day off dedicated for you to use to invest in your growth and development.
Subject to plan and program terms and conditions

What You Need To Know

CIBC is committed to creating an inclusive environment where all team members and clients feel like they belong. We seek applicants with a wide range of abilities and we provide an accessible candidate experience. If you need accommodation, please contact Mailbox.careers-carrieres@cibc.com
CIBC is committed to clarity in our hiring process. All roles posted are opportunities we’re actively recruiting for, unless stated otherwise.
You need to be legally eligible to work at the location(s) specified above and, where applicable, must have a valid work or study permit.
We may ask you to complete an attribute-based assessment and other skills test (such as simulation, coding, French proficiency).
We use artificial intelligence tools during the recruitment process. Our goal for the application process is to get to know more about you, all that you have to offer, and give you the opportunity to learn more about us.

Employment Type

Regular

jobs.title: Assistant Vice President, Accounting Advisory
jobs.description:
You are as unique as your background, experience and point of view. Here, you’ll be encouraged, empowered and challenged to be your best self. You'll work with dynamic colleagues - experts in their fields - who are eager to share their knowledge with you. Your leaders will inspire and help you reach your potential and soar to new heights. Every day, you'll have new and exciting opportunities to make life brighter for our Clients - who are at the heart of everything we do.

At Sun Life, we're driven by our Purpose: helping our Clients achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives. Our values shape how we work: caring, authentic, bold, inspiring, and impactful.

When you join Sun Life, you'll work with passionate colleagues and empowering leaders who support your growth and celebrate your contributions, so you can make a meaningful difference in our Clients' lives.

Discover how you can make a difference in the lives of individuals, families and communities around the world.

Job Description:

About The Job

Reporting to the Vice President and Chief Accountant, the AVP, Accounting Advisory will provide accounting advice on complex transactions, including acquisitions, divestitures, capital and tax initiatives. The role is also responsible for monitoring financial reporting trends and developments and assessing their impact on Sunlife, including regulatory change and emerging standards and topics (EST).

As a corporate function, the AVP, Accounting Advisory has global responsibilities across all of Sunlife’s business groups: Sunlife Canada, Sunlife U.S., Sunlife Asia, Asset Management and Corporate/Enterprise Services. The AVP will work as a peer to another AVP, Accounting Advisory; together, they are supported by a team of Directors and Managers.

What You'll Be Doing

Advise Business Groups and Corporate on the application of IFRS to strategic and business initiatives, M&A and other planned transactions. Collaborate with business leaders to explore alternatives, where appropriate, and develop accounting positions consistent with established policies and financial reporting requirements.
Lead the implementation of new and amended IFRS Accounting Standards and assess the impact of IASB and IFRIC developments on Sunlife’s accounting policies and disclosures.
Lead the adoption and embedding of IFRS 18, Presentation and Disclosure in Financial Statements, including management-defined performance measures (MPMs).
Lead cross-functional working groups to consider the implications of new requirements and develop accounting recommendations on key policy decisions.
Lead initiatives that drive continuous improvement in how we execute our work, including greater use of technology, automation and AI.
Represent accounting policy positions with the external auditors and resolve related audit enquiries.
Prepare accounting position papers and summaries of significant judgments for senior management and, where appropriate, the Audit Committee.
Develop training programs and global communications outlining new accounting policies and financial reporting developments.
Manage and prioritize multiple competing tasks and deliverables.

What You'll Need To Succeed

University degree in accounting or commerce, a CPA designation (or equivalent, such as CPA (US) or CA), and a minimum of 10 years of accounting advisory and financial reporting experience.
Experience in a public accounting firm or a large, complex public company with international operations is preferred. Prior experience in a financial institution or insurance company is highly desired; knowledge of IFRS 17, insurance products and related accounting issues is a strong asset.
Deep technical expertise, strong analytical skills and an in-depth understanding of the application of IFRS. Knowledge of US GAAP and US statutory (NAIC) requirements is an asset.
Proven ability to influence senior leaders without formal authority and to work effectively with multiple stakeholders across geographies and businesses.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical matters clearly and concisely to senior and non-technical audiences.
Ability to lead significant change across a complex, matrixed, international enterprise.
Strong people, process and project leadership skills, with the ability to mobilize internal and external resources to deliver key initiatives and projects.
Ability to develop creative yet practical solutions that meet the needs of the organization.
Experienced people leader with a solid track record of building, motivating and developing a small, high-performing team.
Logical, intellectually curious, proactive and energetic; enjoys collaborating with others while taking ownership of complex projects through to successful completion.
Thrives in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
The ambition and potential to take on more senior leadership roles in the future.

What's in it for you:

Being a member of the Sunlife family, a group of people united by our Purpose: to help Clients and Employees achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives.
We’re also listed as one of the Best Workplaces for Women and Best Workplaces with Most Trusted Executive Teams.
Our unique Sabbatical Program gives you the opportunity to take up to 6 weeks off, every five years.
Care Days available for self-care or care of others (i.e., family or others you may support) and Sick Days to support your well-being.

The Base Pay range is for the primary location for which the job is posted. It may vary depending on the work location of the successful candidate or other factors. In addition to Base Pay, eligible Sun Life employees participate in various incentive plans, payment under which is discretionary and subject to individual and company performance. Certain sales focused roles have sales incentive plans based on individual or group sales results.

Diversity and inclusion have always been at the core of our values at Sun Life. A diverse workforce with wide perspectives and creative ideas benefits our Clients, the communities where we operate and all of us as colleagues. We welcome applications from qualified individuals from all backgrounds.

Persons with disabilities who need accommodation in the application process, or those needing job postings in an alternative format, may e-mail a request to thebrightside@sunlife.com.

We are proud to be a hybrid organization that offers our employees the choice and flexibility to work from both the office and virtually based on the needs of the business, our Clients and you.

We may use artificial intelligence to support candidate sourcing, screening, interview scheduling.

We thank all applicants for showing an interest in this position. Only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

155,000/155 000 - 225,000/225 000

jobs.title: Director, Guaranteed Wealth Solutions Transformation
jobs.description:
The Director, Guaranteed Wealth Solutions (GWS) Transformation is a senior individual contributor responsible for designing the national strategy and future-state advisor support model across Guaranteed Wealth Solutions. This role brings together business strategy, advisor experience, digital enablement and operational expertise to create a coordinated, scalable service model from case submission through inforce servicing.

Working collaboratively across Sales, Delivery, Relationship Management, Operations, Product, Digital, Technology, Risk, Compliance and the Contact Centre, the Director will establish alignment on service pathways, accountabilities, hand-offs and performance expectations. This is an opportunity to lead meaningful transformation, influence enterprise partners and develop practical solutions that enhance advisor experience, enable growth and improve operational efficiency.

Position Responsibilities

Lead the design of the national GWS advisor support strategy and future-state service model.
Develop an integrated target operating model across the advisor journey, establishing clear service standards, channel strategies, accountabilities, hand-offs and escalation pathways.
Leverage advisor feedback, service performance data and operational insights to identify opportunities for simplification, improved service delivery, reduced avoidable demand and enhanced advisor experience.
Advance digital-first servicing through self-service capabilities, automation, proactive communications and intelligent routing, while ensuring appropriate human support for complex or higher-risk needs.
Influence cross-functional partners and senior leaders to align strategic priorities, develop actionable recommendations and business cases, and transition approved solutions to the appropriate functional owners.
Establish governance, performance measures and risk management frameworks that support operational readiness, accountability and measurable business outcomes.

Required Qualifications

10 years of relevant, progressively senior experience in financial services, insurance, wealth management, operations, distribution support or a related field.
Proven experience leading complex, cross-functional transformation initiatives, service model design or operating model development.
Strong understanding of Guaranteed Wealth Solutions products, distribution models, advisor servicing ecosystems and operational processes.
Demonstrated ability to leverage data and operational insights, influence without direct authority, build stakeholder alignment and translate strategy into actionable recommendations.

Preferred Qualifications

Post-secondary degree in business or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience; an advanced degree is an asset.
Experience developing future-state strategies and transitioning approved solutions to accountable business owners.
Strong understanding of independent advisors, national accounts and distribution back-office partners.
Experience leading digital transformation, automation, continuous improvement and organizational change.
Excellent executive communication, negotiation and relationship-building skills, with sound judgment in managing ambiguity, competing priorities and complex business challenges.
Bilingualism (English and French) is an asset. If the successful candidate is in Québec, proficiency in both languages will be required to support clients from various provinces outside of Quebec.

When You Join Our Team

We’ll empower you to learn and grow the career you want.
We’ll recognize and support you in a flexible environment where well-being and inclusion are more than just words.
As part of our global team, we’ll support you in shaping the future you want to see.

The role being advertised is an existing vacancy.

jobs.title: Director of People Operations
jobs.description:
Artificial Intelligence. Actual Impact.

At Docebo, we’re using AI to change how people learn at work—and we mean actually change it. We’re an AI-powered learning platform that helps organizations create, deliver, and manage training all in one place. But our real mission goes deeper: we help teams move faster, work smarter, and focus on the work that truly matters. Our platform is built with intelligent, time-saving tools that personalize learning, eliminate busywork, and turn training from a checkbox into a superpower. The result? Better experiences for learners and real results for businesses.

We’re shaping the future of learning with a team that isn’t afraid to challenge the status quo. If you're excited by the idea of using AI to make work-life better for real people–you’ll feel right at home here. And it’s not just what we build, it’s how we show up. At Docebo, our values aren’t just posters on the wall—they guide how we work every day. We call it the Docebo Heart
: trust by default, assume positive intent, and create space for different perspectives to thrive.

Want to get a better feel for what it's like to work at Docebo? Check out our Life page on our LinkedIn to get a glimpse into our culture, people, and the experiences that make Docebo a great place to grow your career.

So… what are you waiting for? Join 900+ Docebians around the world and help us reinvent the way people learn, because learning never stops.

🚀 The Adventure Ahead

Docebo is scaling fast, and this isn’t a "keep the lights on" role—it’s a ground-up opportunity to reimagine and build a global People Operations engine that actually works for humans. As the architect behind our operational infrastructure, you’ll operate at the intersection of high-level strategy and hands-on execution to empower 900+ Docebians across the globe, with a special focus on EMEA. You’ll partner directly with senior leaders to turn organizational complexity into clarity, designing the scalable systems, global standards, and seamless employee experiences that will fuel our next chapter of hyper-growth.

🛠️ The Day-to-Day

Architect & Scale People Ops: Rebuild and lead a high-performing global People Operations team, clarifying roles and workflows while designing scalable frameworks for a 900+ multi-country organization.
Drive Strategic Partnerships: Set a multi-year People Ops vision and act as a trusted advisor to the People Leadership Team and senior executives, using data and insights to shape company-wide priorities and decisions.
Champion Global & EMEA Compliance: Serve as our go-to expert for EMEA employment practices—navigating works councils, local labor laws, and contracts—while partnering with regional leaders to support seamless expansion into new countries.
Optimize HR Tech & Data: Own our HR systems ecosystem (HRIS, payroll, benefits) to drive process automation, reporting accuracy, and strict GDPR and global data privacy controls.
Lead End-to-End Delivery: Own the People Ops project portfolio from intake to adoption, applying strong project management discipline to land cross-functional system implementations and global rollouts on time.
Elevate the Employee Lifecycle: Oversee operational excellence across every touchpoint—from hiring, onboarding, and job architecture to compensation, performance cycles, employee relations, and offboarding.
Navigate Growth & Change: Lead with calm and clarity through rapid scaling, balancing immediate operational needs with long-term organizational design across every region and function.

⚡ Your Superpowers

Bring Proven Global Scale: You have 10+ years of progressive People Operations/HR leadership in high-growth SaaS or tech, with a track record of scaling operations and restructuring teams for 1,000+ global employees.
Think Enterprise-Wide: You possess the strategic mindset to zoom out, influence senior leaders, and set multi-year operational direction beyond your own function.
Master EMEA Complexity: You bring deep, hands-on expertise in EMEA employment law, works councils, and navigating the nuances of cross-country HR operations.
Execute with Discipline: You’re a project management powerhouse who thrives on delivering complex, multi-region initiatives and driving genuine stakeholder adoption.
Optimize Systems & Data: You’ve successfully implemented and optimized HR systems at scale, pairing a detail-oriented, data-driven approach with a deep care for the human employee experience.
Roll Up Your Sleeves: You balance long-term vision with a willingness to dive into the weeds—untangling messy processes or pressure-testing systems whenever the team needs a boost.
Thrive in Ambiguity: You’re energized by fast-paced, evolving environments, bringing structure, momentum, and calm to complex challenges without sacrificing quality.

Our Hybrid Work Philosophy 🤝

Great work can happen anywhere but coming together helps us go further. Our team spends three days a week in the office (Tuesday-Thursday) to collaborate, solve problems, and learn from each other. With flexibility the rest of the week, it’s a balance designed to help everyone do their best work and keep growing.

Our Total Rewards Philosophy
🎉

Our Total Rewards Philosophy centers around three core areas to reward and care for our People:

Rewarding Impact: We lead with competitive pay to reward the impact, skills and traits that fuel our success.
Fostering Holistic Wellbeing: We care deeply about and invest in the whole person with programs that support our people’s physical, mental, and financial well-being.
Empowering Our Talent Culture: We build a culture of trust and empowerment by designing our rewards and benefits with transparency, equity, and flexibility, enabling our people to do their best work and stay for the long haul.

Our Promise to You
😍

Financial Wellness: Own a piece of Docebo through our Employee Share Purchase Plan (ESPP) at a 15% discount, plus a competitive compensation package.
Your Well-Being, Covered: You’ll get access to health benefits, so you can get the care you need when you need it.
Rest, Relax, Repeat: Rest and recharge with paid vacation days, two company-wide Docebo Days, floating holidays for cultural celebrations, and your birthday off!
Family First: We provide coverage offering you time with your little one(s) so you can soak up all those precious moments. Fun fact: we had 30 Docebian babies join the family in 2025!
Connections That Count: Connect with global communities through our Employee Resource Groups (including PRIDE, DWA, BIDOC, and Green Ambassadors) and company-wide events that keep the fun rolling all year long.

About Docebo 💙

At Docebo, we create seamless, AI-powered learning experiences for over 3,000 customers worldwide. We have successfully achieved two IPOs (TSX: DCBO & NASDAQ: DCBO), been recognized as a top SaaS e-learning solution, and are growing exponentially in the process. We're a global company, with office across North America, EMEA, APAC, and beyond. Our team is guided by five core values— Grow Together Win Together, Build with Our Customer, Clear is Kind, Own Outcomes, Progress Over Perfection
—that shape everything we do. If this resonates with you, now is the perfect time to join one of the fastest-growing learning technology companies in the world.

Docebo is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We are committed to diversity and inclusion in our workforce. All qualified applicants and employees will receive consideration for employment regardless of their race, colour, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, citizenship status, age, disability, genetic information, or any other category protected under applicable law.

As a federal contractor, Docebo is committed to the principles of affirmative action and equal employment opportunity for protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. Docebo does not discriminate because of protected veteran status or on the basis of disability, and Docebo takes affirmative action to employ and advance in employment qualified protected veterans and individuals with disabilities.

Any individuals requiring a reasonable accommodation or would like to voluntarily disclose a disability or protected veteran status to assist with their employment application should send an e-mail to their recruiter directly.

Collaborate with business leaders to explore alternatives, where appropriate, and develop accounting positions consistent with established policies and financial reporting requirements.
Lead the implementation of new and amended IFRS Accounting Standards and assess the impact of IASB and IFRIC developments on Sunlife’s accounting policies and disclosures.
Lead the adoption and embedding of IFRS 18, Presentation and Disclosure in Financial Statements, including management-defined performance measures (MPMs).
Lead cross-functional working groups to consider the implications of new requirements and develop accounting recommendations on key policy decisions.
Lead initiatives that drive continuous improvement in how we execute our work, including greater use of technology, automation and AI.
Represent accounting policy positions with the external auditors and resolve related audit enquiries.
Prepare accounting position papers and summaries of significant judgments for senior management and, where appropriate, the Audit Committee.
Develop training programs and global communications outlining new accounting policies and financial reporting developments.
Manage and prioritize multiple competing tasks and deliverables.

What You'll Need To Succeed

University degree in accounting or commerce, a CPA designation (or equivalent, such as CPA (US) or CA), and a minimum of 10 years of accounting advisory and financial reporting experience.
Experience in a public accounting firm or a large, complex public company with international operations is preferred. Prior experience in a financial institution or insurance company is highly desired; knowledge of IFRS 17, insurance products and related accounting issues is a strong asset.
Deep technical expertise, strong analytical skills and an in-depth understanding of the application of IFRS. Knowledge of US GAAP and US statutory (NAIC) requirements is an asset.
Proven ability to influence senior leaders without formal authority and to work effectively with multiple stakeholders across geographies and businesses.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical matters clearly and concisely to senior and non-technical audiences.
Ability to lead significant change across a complex, matrixed, international enterprise.
Strong people, process and project leadership skills, with the ability to mobilize internal and external resources to deliver key initiatives and projects.
Ability to develop creative yet practical solutions that meet the needs of the organization.
Experienced people leader with a solid track record of building, motivating and developing a small, high-performing team.
Logical, intellectually curious, proactive and energetic; enjoys collaborating with others while taking ownership of complex projects through to successful completion.
Thrives in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
The ambition and potential to take on more senior leadership roles in the future.

What's in it for you:

Being a member of the Sunlife family, a group of people united by our Purpose: to help Clients and Employees achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives.
We’re also listed as one of the Best Workplaces for Women and Best Workplaces with Most Trusted Executive Teams.
Our unique Sabbatical Program gives you the opportunity to take up to 6 weeks off, every five years.
Care Days available for self-care or care of others (i.e., family or others you may support) and Sick Days to support your well-being.

The Base Pay range is for the primary location for which the job is posted. It may vary depending on the work location of the successful candidate or other factors. In addition to Base Pay, eligible Sun Life employees participate in various incentive plans, payment under which is discretionary and subject to individual and company performance. Certain sales focused roles have sales incentive plans based on individual or group sales results.

Diversity and inclusion have always been at the core of our values at Sun Life. A diverse workforce with wide perspectives and creative ideas benefits our Clients, the communities where we operate and all of us as colleagues. We welcome applications from qualified individuals from all backgrounds.

Persons with disabilities who need accommodation in the application process, or those needing job postings in an alternative format, may e-mail a request to thebrightside@sunlife.com.

We are proud to be a hybrid organization that offers our employees the choice and flexibility to work from both the office and virtually based on the needs of the business, our Clients and you.
